1.t: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),

2.t: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.

3.t: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.

4.t: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.

5.t: And thou wilt see and they will see

6.t: Which of you is the demented.

7.t: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

8.t: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

9.t: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

10.t: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,

12.t: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor

14.t: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

15.t: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.

16.t: We shall brand him on the nose.

17.t: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,

18.t: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);

19.t: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

20.t: And in the morning it was as if plucked.

21.t: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,

22.t: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

23.t: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:

24.t: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.

25.t: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.

26.t: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!

28.t: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

29.t: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.

30.t: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.

31.t: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.

32.t: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.

33.t: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.

34.t: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.

35.t: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?

36.t: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!

37.t: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn

38.t: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?

39.t: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?

40.t: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!

41.t: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

42.t: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,

43.t: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.

44.t: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.

45.t: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.

46.t: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?

47.t: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?

48.t: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.

49.t: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.

50.t: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.

51.t: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;

52.t: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
